label: SMOKE fixture — Associated Press reporting (accurate element)
summary: AP reported that factory activity had expanded for seven months and reached its highest level since May 2022, but the improvement had not produced a hiring boom; the U.S. had 95,000 fewer factory jobs in June than before Trump's return to office.
title: FACT FOCUS: Trump boasts about the economy but there's more to the story
nuance: Accurate element of the claim as reported.
